pages.text: A world of its own above the overworld: black sky and stars, the huge Earth below across the horizon, the same sun, moon, day and night. The leviathan, the Hyperion and the mothership hang there over their bases.$(br2)You cannot fly up alone: ride a flying unit (or play as one, or sit in a transport) above height 300. Whatever falls below its floor comes down into the overworld high over the same place; a player falls slowly for 30 seconds.$(br2)$(l)The way aboard$(): destroy a race base's main building (the hatchery of the lair, a command center, a nexus) — a portal to its ship opens where it stood (the portal hall under the base wakes too); kill the guards round it and step in. Once its guardian is freed, the heroic transport flies you up as well (see Guardians of the Bases).
